imaging.title: 肾门层面的CT
imaging.blurb: 非增强CT常用来寻找高密度影。图像是教学切片，不是某个人的报告。
imaging.blurbEn: Non-contrast CT is often used to look for dense shadows. A teaching slice, not a personal report.

imaging.title: 超声下的肾下极结石
imaging.blurb: 超声用回声和声影描述结石。去标识的教学图，没有可辨认的面孔。
imaging.blurbEn: Ultrasound describes stones with echoes and shadowing. A de-identified teaching frame. No identifiable face.

imaging.title: 腹部X光上的致密影
imaging.titleEn: Dense shadow on an abdominal radiograph
imaging.blurb: 部分结石在X光上显影，尿酸石常常不显影。这是成像物理，不是诊断。
imaging.blurbEn: Some stones show on X-ray. Uric acid stones often do not. Imaging physics, not a diagnosis.

imaging.title: 肾脏剖面图
imaging.blurb: 剖面帮助认出皮质、髓质和肾盂。解剖课图片。
imaging.blurbEn: A section helps label cortex, medulla, and pelvis. An anatomy-class picture.

imaging.title: 结石标本特写
imaging.blurb: 特写用来看表面纹理。标本摄影，不是病人肖像。
imaging.blurbEn: A close-up shows surface texture. Specimen photography, not a patient portrait.

imaging.title: 冲击波发生器
imaging.blurb: 体外碎石机的外观。器械照片，不代表某次治疗。
imaging.blurbEn: The outside of a shock-wave machine. A device photo, not a particular treatment.

imaging.title: 矢状与轴位CT
imaging.blurb: 同一检查可以有不同切面。去标识的教学拼图。
imaging.blurbEn: One exam can have several planes. A de-identified teaching collage.

imaging.title: 肾脏超声切面
imaging.blurb: 超声切面呈扇形。教学帧，没有面孔。
imaging.blurbEn: Ultrasound slices look fan-shaped. A teaching frame without a face.

imaging.title: 鹿角石的影像
imaging.blurb: 铸型可以在影像上画出肾盂轮廓。形态学，不是点名。
imaging.blurbEn: A cast can outline the pelvis on imaging. Morphology, not a named person.

imaging.title: 编号肾脏图
imaging.blurb: 编号图把结构一一标出。课堂用图。
imaging.blurbEn: A numbered plate labels each structure. A classroom figure.

imaging.title: 四毫米结石标本
imaging.blurb: 尺子帮助对照大小分级。砂粒、小结石、鹿角石是教学标签。
imaging.blurbEn: A ruler helps size-class teaching. Grit, small, and staghorn are labels for class, not a verdict.

imaging.title: 支架置入后的影像
imaging.blurb: 支架在影像上呈弯曲的管道。器械位置教学，不是某位病人的档案。
imaging.blurbEn: A stent looks like a curved tube on imaging. Device-position teaching, not a personal file.
